### Before we merge

- Sign off each commit with `git commit -s`. It confirms you wrote the change and can contribute it, and [the contributing guide](https://github.com/legesher/legesher/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#how-to-sign-off-your-commits) explains it in a minute.
- Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/), for example `fix(i18n): correct a keyword in the Swahili pack`. If yours don't yet, a maintainer can help when merging.
- [DEVELOPMENT.md](https://github.com/legesher/legesher/blob/main/DEVELOPMENT.md) has the setup and the commands that run the tests locally.
